description: squirrelscan is a website auditing service focused on SEO, performance, security, and AI-agent readiness checks. It can run audits locally via CLI and adds cloud features such as hosted crawling, reports, credits, and MCP access.
summary: squirrelscan exposes three developer integration surfaces on its own domain: a REST API at `https://api.squirrelscan.com` with OpenAPI, a hosted streamable-HTTP MCP server at `https://mcp.squirrelscan.com/mcp`, and the `squirrel` CLI; authentication uses org API keys, CLI login tokens, and MCP OAuth sign-in depending on surface.
